QuestInfo.name: A Hero's Duty 1
QuestInfo.0: You found citizens under siege in the subway. Calm them down and find out what exactly happened.
QuestInfo.1: Monsters attacked the citizens, and some are hurt. Go to the next car and check if there are any more.
QuestInfo.2: Some people were left behind in the subway cars. Go save them.

speech.1: Oh! You got rid of the monsters! Are you that superhero...?

0.0: Help me! Oh, are you that hero? Strange things attacked us!
0.1: I'm okay... but the others need help! There are people collapsed in the car back there.

yes.0: You ARE that hero! Please, save us!

no.0: T-then who will save them? We're doomed!

1.0: K-keep playing dead. Even bears ignore you when you play dead...

0.msg: #b(The citizens are afraid and can't think straight. Defeat the monsters and then talk to them again.)#k
